SUBS-031.notes: Payment request while unpaid; tax invoice numbered on payment (PREFIX/YY-YY/NNNNN, at most 16 characters, a series per financial year); printable; final once paid or void.

INTG-009.notes: Razorpay Payment Links and webhooks, set up in Platform admin → Payments. Tested against a local stand-in of the API; needs a check with real Razorpay test keys.

INTG-007.notes: Stripe Checkout Sessions and webhooks, set up in Platform admin → Payments. Tested against a local stand-in of the API; needs a check with real Stripe test keys.

ADMIN-015.notes: Platform admin → Invoices (all subscription invoices, record a payment by hand, void, ask the gateway, issue due renewals, gateway notices) and → Payments (gateways and seller details).

ADMIN-012.notes: Tickets with topic and urgency, first-answer and resolution targets by urgency (1h/8h urgent to 72h/7d low, clock hours), a queue ordered by whose turn it is and the nearest target, assignment, internal notes never shown to the customer, replies emailed through the organisation's mail set-up, append-only messages, every status change in the organisation's audit chain.

ADMIN-022.notes: Only an owner or admin can grant; 1 to 72 hours with a reason, optionally tied to a ticket; one grant at a time; revocable; support staff get viewer rights for GET requests only (writes 403 SUPPORT_READ_ONLY); every request logged in an append-only table the organisation sees; grants can only be revoked once (database trigger).

NAV-044.notes: Help and support in the Governance group (and for staff who only claim expenses).

SUBS-018.notes: Each plan's monthly AI requests are metered and enforced before every model call (429 AI_CREDITS_USED_UP). Platform administrators offer packs of extra requests (INR and USD); owners buy one under Usage through a CREDITS tax invoice paid online, and its requests are used after the plan's, from the pack expiring first, for a year from payment.

SUBS-019.notes: Each plan's monthly uploads are counted per stored attachment and enforced inside the upload's transaction under a per-organisation lock (429 UPLOAD_LIMIT_REACHED); refused and duplicate files are not counted.

ADMIN-008.notes: Platform admin → Usage: AI requests and tokens and uploads per organisation per month against each plan, fullest first, with totals and organisations at or near a limit.

ADMIN-007.notes: Flags declared in code with defaults; administrators switch one off for everyone, roll it out to a stable hashed share of organisations, or set it for one organisation (kept in that organisation's audit trail). The API refuses a switched-off module with 403 FEATURE_OFF and the menu hides it. Four modules are behind flags so far.

ADMIN-010.notes: Requests per route pattern over the last 15 minutes: counts, 4xx and 5xx, p50 and p95, and requests per minute. In memory per API server instance; not aggregated across instances.

ADMIN-011.notes: System health measured on request: database latency, size, connections, PostgreSQL version and migrations; API version, uptime, memory and load; each background runner's last pass, duration, failures and lateness. No external metrics system or alerting to an on-call service yet.

ADMIN-017.notes: Every unexpected 5xx is recorded with its request id (shown to the person as a reference), grouped by error kind, code location and route; findable by reference; resolve and reopen; a resolved group that recurs opens again. Occurrences kept 30 days. Errors in the web app's browser code are not collected yet.

ADMIN-020.notes: Start now or schedule a maintenance window with a message and expected end. While in progress every change by anyone but platform staff is refused (503 MAINTENANCE with Retry-After); reads, sign-in and payment webhooks keep working, background runners skip their passes, and a banner shows on every page including sign-in.

SEC-025.notes: pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=high as a CI job, and weekly Dependabot updates for npm, GitHub Actions and base images. Four high-severity transitive advisories fixed with pinned overrides (audit clean locally). The CI job has not run on GitHub because Actions is blocked by billing.

CRM-003.notes: Leads LD-0001 with source, owner (a member), estimated value; NEW/CONTACTED/QUALIFIED/DISQUALIFIED (reason required, reopenable); duplicate warning by email against leads and contacts; converted once into a new or existing customer (a vendor becomes a customer too), optionally with a deal. Never deleted; a converted lead is frozen by a trigger; append-only activity timeline (calls, emails, meetings, notes, every change).

CRM-004.notes: Deals DL-0001 for a customer through PROSPECTING/QUALIFICATION/PROPOSAL/NEGOTIATION to WON (100%) or LOST (0%, reason required), reopenable; default stage probabilities overridable; weighted value; board by stage, overdue deals, 90-day win rate and days to win, weighted value by expected close month; deals on the customer page. Single currency (functional) for now.

CRM-001.notes: Native lightweight CRM (leads, pipeline, quotations, orders, contracts, customer 360, revenue forecast) and integration APIs for external CRMs: API keys made under Settings > Integrations (hashed, scoped read/write, expiry, revoke, act as their creator), the CRM API at /v1/crm-api (also /api/crm on the app) with idempotent creation by externalRef, and signed CRM webhooks from the audit trail with retries, test, delivery log and secret rotation.

CRM-005.notes: Quotations QT-0001 with the invoice tax rules (tax rates, GST place of supply, HSN/SAC); draft (editable, deletable) -> sent (frozen by a trigger) -> accepted or declined (reason); expired past valid-until; revisions QT-0001-R2 supersede the previous one when sent; linked to a deal, which is won on acceptance; acceptance rate on the list. No PDF or e-mail of a quotation yet.

CRM-007.notes: Sales orders SO-0001 from an accepted quotation or entered directly with the customer's PO; lines and prices never change (trigger); open/partly billed/billed; cancel with a reason only while nothing is billed; entering one for a deal wins the deal.

CRM-008.notes: Bill an order in full or by chosen quantities into a draft invoice (reference SO-0001 / customer PO) built by the normal invoice rules; billed quantities count while the invoice is draft or posted and are freed when it is voided or the draft deleted; over-billing refused under a row lock.

CRM-006.notes: Customer contracts CT-0001: monthly/quarterly/half-yearly/yearly, in advance or arrears, fixed end on a period end or rolling; draft -> active <-> paused -> ended/cancelled; renew by hand (with % price change) or automatically; renewal-due flag from notice days; MRR/ARR; append-only history; activating for a deal wins it.

AR-010.notes: Each due contract period becomes a draft invoice (invoice rules incl. GST), by the background runner (CONTRACT_RUNNER_INTERVAL_SECONDS), on activation, Bill now, or Bill due periods now; each period recorded once (no double billing); deleted/voided invoice can be billed again; failures kept on the contract and retried. Invoices are drafts to check and post; no auto-posting or auto-email yet.

AR-029.notes: Contract billing from the contract's lines in force on the billing day; price changes and renewals apply to later periods only; reference CT-0001 <period> / customer reference.

AR-011.notes: Fixed-fee recurring billing works through contracts (CRM-006/AR-010), usage charges through meters (AR-012), and part periods are billed by days when a contract is billed on a fixed day of the month. Cancelling part-way through a period billed in advance credits the unused days on a draft credit note per invoice (preview in the cancel dialog). Not built: card or mandate auto-collection (needs a payment gateway).

CRM-010.notes: Customer profitability: revenue (income lines of posted invoices less credit notes) less direct costs (expenses posted to the customer's linked projects), monthly for 12 months and to date; ranked on Customer insights.

CRM-011.notes: Lifetime value = gross profit to date + yearly gross profit (max of trailing 12m revenue and contract ARR, at the customer's margin) x expected years r/(1-r) (max 5) from the org's own 12-month retention; 3 years assumed (and shown) with fewer than 5 customers to measure.

CRM-012.notes: Credit risk score 0-100 from 5 explained factors (overdue share, oldest overdue, days late, limit use, slowing), ratings low/medium/high/very high, suggested credit limit, credit hold that blocks invoice posting with audit trail.

CRM-013.notes: Deterministic forecast by month from active contracts (by invoice date, auto-renew runs on), open orders (left to bill, this month), open deals (weighted/full at close month) and the 3-month run rate of other sales; committed/expected/best; itemised; saved forecasts RF-0001 (immutable) compared with actual revenue (WAPE). AI explanation not built yet.

INTG-025.notes: Any CRM platform can connect through the generic CRM API (API keys) and CRM webhooks. Ready-made connectors for named platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho) that map their objects automatically are not built.

AR-031.notes: Invoices, credit notes, bills, vendor credits, receipts and payments in any supported currency, at the recorded rate on the date or one entered and kept with the record. Settling at another rate posts a realised exchange gain or loss (reversed if the allocation is removed). Receivables and payables, ageing, balances, credit limits and approvals are in the functional currency at each record's rate; customer statements are per currency. Not yet: TDS/TCS, reverse charge or GST charged on foreign-currency documents, e-invoices for them, quotations/orders/contracts in other currencies, rate feeds.

BANK-012.notes: Receipts and payments in a foreign currency into any bank account, realised gains and losses on settlement, period-end revaluation of foreign balances, and bank accounts kept in another currency: statements imported, matched, booked and reconciled in that currency while the books carry the functional amount. Not built: one-entry currency exchange between two accounts, AI suggestions on foreign accounts.

DS-012.notes: Currency and exchange-rate picker on invoices, bills, credits and payments: shows the recorded rate on the date and the home-currency amount.

GL-012.notes: Templates with lines (any currency, departments, projects), memo, reference and placeholders such as {month}; used by hand as a draft or posted, saved from any manual journal, archived once used.

GL-007.notes: Template schedules monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or yearly, on the start day or the month's last day, to an end date or until ended; each run a draft or a posted Recurring journal, made once (numbered, in one transaction), by the hourly runner or Run due now; failures kept and retried; pause, resume (catch up or skip), end. Not yet: weekly or custom calendars, auto-reversing templates.

AR-026.notes: Provision matrix from the receivables ageing (rate per bucket, editable), specific provisions for invoices marked doubtful at their own percentage, foreign invoices at their own rate; each provision posts only the difference from the allowance in the books (increase or release) as a BAD_DEBT journal, kept append-only with the matrix it used. Not yet: provision rates learnt from history (expected-credit-loss model), provisions per customer group.

AR-027.notes: Write off all or part of a posted invoice against the allowance (refused beyond what it holds) or straight to bad-debt expense, at the invoice's own exchange rate; settles the invoice like a receipt, so ageing, statement and control account agree, without changing GST returns or e-invoices; reversible once (journal and settlement reversed). Not yet: GST bad-debt relief, write-offs of payables or small balances in bulk.

GL-011.notes: Year-end close: revenue and expense accounts closed to a chosen retained earnings account by a CLOSING journal (YE-) on the year's last day, previewed line by line; closing again posts only what changed; reopening reverses the closes. Profit-and-loss reports, KPIs, budgets, dimensions, CFO, recovery and month-end checks leave CLOSING journals out; balance sheet and trial balance include them. Not yet: closing by department or project, automatic lock after closing.

AP-014.notes: Payment batches PB-0001: draft (bills, part payments) -> approved by someone other than the preparer (self-approval only when no one else can approve, flagged) -> bank file CSV (beneficiary, account, IFSC, amount, reference) -> payments recorded, one per vendor, settling the bills; cancel with a reason. A bill is in one open batch at most; approved batches are frozen by a trigger. Functional currency only; no direct bank API (H2H) upload yet.

AP-027.notes: Vendor bank details (account holder, number, IFSC) with an append-only masked change history; any change clears verification in the database; verification needs approvals.decide and someone other than the person who changed them (unless no one else can); batches with unverified or changed details cannot be approved, sent to the bank or paid.

AR-005.notes: Same feature as CRM-005: Quotations QT-0001 with the invoice tax rules (tax rates, GST place of supply, HSN/SAC); draft (editable, deletable) -> sent (frozen by a trigger) -> accepted or declined (reason); expired past valid-until; revisions QT-0001-R2 supersede the previous one when sent; linked to a deal, which is won on acceptance; acceptance rate on the list. No PDF or e-mail of a quotation yet.

AR-007.notes: Same feature as CRM-007: Sales orders SO-0001 from an accepted quotation or entered directly with the customer's PO; lines and prices never change (trigger); open/partly billed/billed; cancel with a reason only while nothing is billed; entering one for a deal wins the deal.

AR-017.notes: Debit notes DN-000001: an INVOICE linked to an earlier posted invoice (same customer, currency, place of supply, not before it); owed, aged and paid like an invoice; GSTR-1 9B type D with the original number, table 13 own series, GSTR-3B outward tax, e-invoice DBN, print titled Debit note with Against invoice. Invoice cannot be voided while a debit note stands (trigger). Sales side only.

AP-005.notes: Recurring bills RB-0001: vendor, lines (GST rate, SAC, dimensions), place of supply, reverse charge, TDS section, due days; monthly/quarterly/half-yearly/yearly schedule (month end, end date) that makes each due run as a draft or posted bill through the normal bill code (GST, TDS, approval rules, periods, duplicate vendor reference). The vendor reference must carry a placeholder that changes each run. The first bill is checked on save inside a rolled-back savepoint. Runs recorded once in the same transaction (append-only); failures kept on the schedule; pause/resume (skip missed)/end; Make recurring from a bill. Hourly runner (RECURRING_BILL_RUNNER_INTERVAL_SECONDS). Functional currency only.

AP-007.notes: Payment schedule: each open bill gets a planned pay date and optional part amount (bill_payment_plans, bills only by trigger); suggested date = due date or the last chosen pay weekday before it, never the past; plans checked (not past, not before bill date, not more than left); weekly planned outflows against ledger bank balances with short weeks flagged (receipts not included); Plan the rest auto-plans unplanned bills; Prepare batch takes bills planned up to a date into a new payment batch with their amounts; Plan payment… from a bill. Functional currency only; planning moves no money.

AR-025.notes: Invoice disputes DS-0001: raised from a posted invoice with something due, for part or all of what is due (checked), with reason, description, owner (a member) and target date; one open per invoice (partial unique index); changes and notes kept in an append-only history; resolved by a posted credit note of the same customer and currency, customer pays, written off or withdrawn, then final (trigger). An open dispute keeps the invoice out of AI payment reminders and the INVOICE_OVERDUE workflow trigger; it still counts in receivables. Summary: open count and amount, past target, oldest, average days to settle, outcomes.

AR-008.notes: Pro forma invoices PF-0001: drafted directly or from a sent/accepted quotation, lines worked out by the invoice rules (GST place of supply); issued then fixed (DB trigger on header and lines); printed with the invoice template as PRO_FORMA (heading Pro forma invoice, Not a tax invoice, Valid until); Make tax invoice creates a draft invoice with the same lines referenced PF-0001, deleting/voiding it frees the pro forma; cancel with reason; posts nothing. Functional currency only; advance via an ordinary receipt applied to the tax invoice.

AP-015.notes: Purchase orders PO-0001: drafted with lines worked out by the bill rules (GST vendor state/place of supply), expected date (late flag), match mode two-way/three-way and price/quantity tolerances; issued then fixed (DB trigger on header and lines); close with reason (short close) or cancel when nothing received/billed; Make bill drafts a bill for what is left to bill; bill lines keep purchase_order_line_id through edits; two-way matching checks price and quantity ordered. Functional currency only.

AP-016.notes: Goods receipts GRN-0001 against issued three-way orders: date, delivery note, accepted and rejected quantity per line with note; over-receipt refused beyond the quantity tolerance; never edited or deleted (DB triggers), cancelled with a reason unless bills rely on the quantity. Does not move stock.

AP-017.notes: Three-way matching of bills against order and goods received: exceptions for price above order (+tolerance), more than ordered, more than received (+tolerance), lines not on the order, order closed/cancelled; several bill lines per order line add up with other non-void bills; posting refused (409 BILL_MATCH_EXCEPTION) until approvals.decide accepts the exact differences with a reason (fingerprinted, append-only, audit); Purchase order match panel on the bill page.

AR-006.notes: Estimates are the quotations of CRM slice 2 (QT-0001, revisions -R2): worked out by the invoice rules, sent, revised, declined, expired, accepted into sales orders; pro forma invoices made from them (AR-008).

AR-013.notes: Sales orders billed by milestones: plan named shares (<=100%), mark reached, make a draft invoice for the share of every line (cumulative target; the last takes what is left). Invoiced milestones locked (API + trigger); void frees. Method fixed once anything is billed. Invoices round per line, so totals can differ from the order by a paisa per line and invoice.

AR-014.notes: Sales orders billed by progress: each claim (percent complete above the previous live claim, <=100) makes a draft invoice billing every line up to that share less earlier claims; 100% bills the rest. Claims immutable (trigger); voided claims no longer count, deleting the draft removes the claim. Retentions not built.

AR-015.notes: Retainers RT-0001: agreed amount and minimum per customer; held as ordinary unapplied receipts linked to the retainer (recorded into it or added); drawn down onto invoices with ordinary allocations, oldest receipt first, oldest due invoice first by default; top-up due below the minimum; close only when empty; triggers keep links permanent. Functional currency only; no GST on advances; top-up requests not emailed.

AR-018.notes: Payment links PL-0001 on posted INR/USD invoices through the organisation's own Razorpay or Stripe account (keys sealed, set up and tested in Settings → Payment gateways, deposit account, one gateway per currency). Settled by the signed webhook or by checking: an ordinary receipt into the deposit account applied to the invoice up to what is owed. One open link per invoice; trigger keeps links permanent and final. Not built: emailing the link from Talk2Tax, refunds, other currencies.

AR-003.notes: One onboarding per customer: details read from the customer (email, address with PIN, GSTIN or PAN, proposed credit terms) plus the organisation's own checklist (files where needed, attachments type CUSTOMER_ONBOARDING); submit, second-person approval (self-approved only when nobody else can) sets credit limit and terms, reject with reason, reopen. Optional setting starts onboarding for every new customer (contacts trigger). Invoices to a customer with an unapproved onboarding do not post. Not built: customer self-service portal.

AP-002.notes: One onboarding per vendor (separate from customer onboarding, own setting and checklist): email, address with PIN, GSTIN or PAN, verified bank details and payment terms read from the vendor, plus the checklist with files; submit, second-person approval sets payment terms (no credit limit), reject, reopen. Optional setting starts one for every new vendor. Bills from and payments to a vendor with an unapproved onboarding are refused. Not built: vendor self-service portal.

AP-021.notes: Scorecard per vendor and period from purchase orders, goods receipts, posted bills and vendor credits: on-time delivery (40), rejected goods by value (30), bills matched without accepted differences (20), team reviews (10), reweighted over what can be measured, grades A-D; overcharge above order price, spend and credits shown. Reviews 1-5 by aspect, optional PO, note needed at 1-2, append-only, withdrawn only by their author. Not built: external risk data.

AP-023.notes: Vendor bank abroad (IBAN mod-97, SWIFT country, ABA checksum, second-person verification); remittance per vendor and currency against posted foreign-currency bills with RBI purpose code, charges OUR/SHA/BEN and Form 15CA part A/B/C/D plus 15CB above Rs 5 lakh per vendor per financial year; approval by another person; CSV remittance instruction marks it sent; recorded at the bank's rate settling the bills. Purpose codes and 15CA rules not reviewed by a banker or CA. Not built: bank API/MT103, section 195 TDS, forwards.

AR-012.notes: Usage charges (meters) on contracts billed in arrears: per unit, graduated or volume tiers, included units, minimum charge. Usage recorded by hand, CSV import (all or nothing) or API, idempotent by reference, voided not deleted, negative corrections. Each period's invoice gets usage lines next to the fixed lines; billed readings frozen by triggers; bill again re-uses them. Not built: advance+usage mix, API keys for usage feeds, part-period proration.

AR-028.notes: Invoice lines for services delivered over time: service start, months (1-120), spread by days or evenly, set on the draft. Posting credits them to the deferred revenue account (2350 by default, configurable) and opens a DEFERRED_REVENUE schedule per line; the monthly release run recognises them. Revenue waterfall (12 months) over all deferred revenue schedules. Voiding takes back what was recognised and ends the schedules. Not built: standalone selling price allocation across bundled lines, credit notes adjusting schedules, milestone or usage-based recognition. Not reviewed against Ind AS 115 / ASC 606 by an accountant.

AR-030.notes: Private link per customer (t2tp_ token, SHA-256 stored, shown once; 30/90/180/365 days or until revoked; revoke; view count and last opened). Portal without sign-in: balance, overdue and unused credits by currency, posted invoices and credit notes with state, payment-link Pay button, receipts, statement with running balance, invoice opened with the business's print template. Per-IP rate limited, no-referrer, noindex, RLS-scoped after the link lookup. Not built: customer sign-in accounts, emailing the link from the app, uploading remittances or raising disputes from the portal, branding/custom domain.

AP-019.notes: Per active vendor: GSTIN and PAN validity and agreement, state, TDS without PAN, duplicate GSTIN/PAN across vendors, GST bills without GSTIN or under an older GSTIN, wrong tax head, plus GST portal checks recorded by people (append-only, audited) flagging cancelled/suspended/composition suppliers and the bills affected, stale checks and name differences. Not built: automatic GSP lookup (needs keys).

AP-024.notes: Risk per active vendor from bank details (shared account, changed/unverified), supplier tax problems, performance grade, share of purchases, new vendor growing fast, onboarding not approved and late payment; level = worst factor. Reviews (decision, note, next review date) append-only and audited; new factor, higher level or due date asks again. VENDOR_RISK alert check. Not built: outside credit/sanctions data, blocking orders on a stop decision.

AR-042.notes: Finds revenue not invoiced from real records: completed milestones without invoice, contract periods due but unbilled (with the runner error), drafts 7+ days old, delivery orders 30+ days with quantity left, expired pro formas without invoice, regular customers missed last month; confidence due now/likely/possible; totals by currency and source. Dismiss/restore with reason (append-only, audited), returns when the amount grows. Not built: an alert check, AI estimation.

AP-013.notes: Private link per vendor (t2tv_ token, SHA-256 stored, shown once; expiry or until revoked). Portal without sign-in: owed/due now by currency, posted bills and credits with due dates, TDS and status, payments with bank reference, issued purchase orders with amount still to invoice, statement. Vendor sends an invoice (number, date, total, PO, note) plus a PDF/image file (sniffed, 5 MB, once within an hour); duplicates by normalised number refused against waiting, recorded and existing bills. Purchases > Vendor invoices: record against a bill of the same vendor (file attached to the bill) or turn down with a reason the vendor sees. Append-only, audited. Not built: sign-in accounts, emailing links, auto-creating bills/reading PDFs (needs AI keys), bank detail changes via portal (deliberately).

EXP-006.notes: Mileage at organisation rates per km (vehicle types as named rates). No map/GPS distance lookup.

BANK-007.notes: Same amount out/in across own accounts within 3 days; recorded as one entry matched to both statement lines. Same-currency accounts.

TAX-024.notes: Notice register with deadlines, files, history and outcomes. Not yet in the compliance calendar; no reminders.

GL-031.notes: Organisation-defined tags with values on journal lines and profit by tag. Not yet on invoice and bill lines, budgets or report export.

GL-028.notes: Locations as the Location preset of financial tags: values per office, store or branch, picked on journal lines, profit by location. Not yet on invoice and bill lines.

AP-031.notes: Rule-based checks against the vendor's earlier bills and bank details, with reviews. Fixed thresholds; no AI explanation yet.

GL-023.notes: Receivables and payables subsidiary ledgers (open items per customer and vendor, ageing, statements) with the control account compared to them at any date on Account reconciliations; the open items can be added as the supporting balance.

GL-025.notes: Profit centres are a financial tag (preset Profit centre, key profit_center): values are defined per organisation, journal lines are checked against them, and Profit by tag gives the profit for each centre. Not built: a hierarchy of profit centres.

GL-027.notes: Business units are a financial tag (preset Business unit, key business_unit) with values per organisation, checked on journal lines and reported by in Profit by tag. Not built: separate ledgers or balance sheets per business unit.

GL-033.notes: Same as ENT-008 and ENT-009: intercompany charges and settlements posted in both companies together, reversed together and eliminated on consolidation.

TRS-012.notes: Fixed deposits: placing, interest to date and at maturity, accruals, closing at maturity or early with tax deducted, and reversal. Not built: mutual funds, bonds and shares, market values and gains.

DS-003.notes: Ctrl+K or ⌘K (or Search in the header) opens a search of the pages this person can open and, with reports access, records: contacts, invoices and bills, payments, journals, accounts, projects, departments, loans, fixed assets and alerts. Arrow keys and Enter, or click. No actions (create, run) from the palette yet.

SUBS-024.notes: Percentage or fixed-amount coupons, limited by plan, billing, number of organisations and a use-by date, for the first 1-36 payments or every payment. Taken off before GST at checkout and on renewals while payments are left; shown on the tax invoice; usage and money taken off in Platform admin → Coupons. A coupon never takes a payment to nothing.

SUBS-025.notes: Promotions are coupons applied automatically: shown beside the plans they fit with their last day, and the one taking the most off is applied at checkout without a code for organisations that have not used it. Never stacked with a coupon; not applied to runner-issued renewals.

SUBS-017.notes: Payroll, foreign currencies and group consolidation can be added to a plan that lacks them, priced per currency and billing by platform administrators. Added at checkout (an upgrade for the days left mid-period), removed at the renewal, carried on renewal invoices, listed on the tax invoice, and counted for module access. The AI assistant is not an add-on (its use is set by a plan's AI requests).

GL-034.notes: Consolidation adjustments in the group's currency, in the consolidation only: goodwill, fair value or unrealised profit entered by hand, shown in the worksheet's Adjustments column, voided once with a reason.

GL-036.notes: Rule-based suggestions for a month: manual journals repeated in each of the last three months but missing, and expense accruals at the three-month average. Accepted as draft journals or dismissed with a reason; decisions recorded once and audited.

SEC-038.notes: Platform-wide AI emergency shutdown by a platform super admin with a reason: every agent's guard refuses (503 AI_SHUTDOWN) before any model call, also mid-run; organisations see the reason and cannot lift it; append-only history, audited. The organisation-level stop is AGENT-060.

SEC-030.notes: Every copilot tool needs a permission checked on every call; owners and admins can turn tools off per organisation. A tool that is off or outside the member's role is never offered to the model and is refused if the model calls it anyway; the list is re-read before each tool round. Copilot actions are re-checked when the member confirms.

SEC-013.notes: Rotation of the key that encrypts stored secrets (integrations, payment gateways, CRM webhooks, two-step sign-in): previous keys keep opening what they sealed, a platform admin re-encrypts everything readable with the current key (audited), unreadable secrets are counted and left for re-entry. Not built: KMS/Vault, JWT signing key rotation, per-organisation keys.

SEC-020.notes: Per-organisation retention periods for working data (copilot conversations, CRM webhook delivery log) with minimums, a daily runner and Apply now, audited; statutory records (books, GST, income tax, payroll, audit trail) are never deleted on a schedule and the page lists India's minimum periods. Not built: retention for uploaded files and email logs, legal hold, export before deletion.

SEC-006.notes: Single sign-on with an organisation's OpenID Connect provider (Entra ID, Google Workspace, Okta, Keycloak, ...): code flow with PKCE and browser-bound state, ID token signature/iss/aud/exp/nonce checks, DNS-TXT-verified email domains, optional join with a role and optional enforcement (owners keep their password), audited. Not built: SAML, SCIM, single logout.

SEC-007.notes: OIDC relying party architecture: per-organisation connection with sealed client secret (key rotation covers it), discovery with issuer check, SSRF-guarded provider requests (public https only, no redirects, size and time limits), JWKS verification of RS/PS/ES algorithms. SAML is not supported.

SEC-018.notes: Uploads (attachments, tax notice files, vendor portal) are limited to 5 MB, typed from their bytes (PDF/PNG/JPEG/WebP), renamed safely, refused when a PDF can run code or carries files (also escaped or in compressed object streams), recorded in file_scans and served back as downloads with nosniff and a sandbox CSP.

SEC-019.notes: ClamAV (clamd INSTREAM over TCP, CLAMAV_URL) scans every upload before it is kept; infected files are refused, and uploads fail closed while the scanner cannot answer. Refusals are audited (file.refused) and shown in Platform admin -> File scanning. Not built: re-scanning stored files.

SEC-029.notes: Copilot only. Successful tool results are checked against five patterns (ignore instructions, new role, imitated chat messages, tool requests, requests for hidden prompts or secrets). A match is sent to the model wrapped in a safety notice and <untrusted_data>, recorded on the answer and in the audit, and propose_* tools are refused for the rest of that answer. Pattern-based: rephrased instructions can get through, which is why proposals still need a member's confirmation.

SEC-031.notes: Copilot only. Before a question or tool result goes to the model: Luhn-valid card numbers, Verhoeff-valid Aadhaar numbers and API keys are always replaced; bank account fields (on by default), PAN, emails and phones as owners and admins choose. Members keep the real text; each answer records and shows counts of what was hidden. Other AI agents (collections, bank, close, CFO) do not redact yet.

SEC-034.notes: Two layers checked before every model call by every agent (the shared AI guard): models allowed across Talk2Tax (super admins, with a reason, insert-only history, audited) and an organisation's narrower list (owners and admins, audited). A model not allowed is refused with 409 MODEL_NOT_ALLOWED before anything is sent; it cannot be saved in Settings → Integrations or used by the connection test. Not per agent or per member.

SEC-037.notes: Each agent may start a limited number of AI tasks in any 60 minutes per organisation: its own limit (owners and admins, 1 to 100,000, audited) or the server's AI_AGENT_TASKS_PER_HOUR (default 500, 0 = none). New work over the limit is refused with 429 AI_TASK_LIMIT before anything is sent; running work stops before its next model call only once over the limit. Alongside existing per-run limits (copilot tool rounds and turn timeout), monthly token budgets and the per-member hourly question limit.

SEC-023.notes: Reads the audit trail every SECURITY_MONITOR_INTERVAL_SECONDS (default 5 min). 23 audit actions are security events (HIGH or MEDIUM). Six rules raise alerts: many lockouts in an hour (SECURITY_LOCKOUT_ALERT_COUNT), failed two-step codes after a right password, platform role changes, a platform admin turning two-step off, infected uploads, 5+ SSO refusals in an hour for an organisation. One alert per rule and key (security_alerts; findings never change or get deleted), each new one emailed once to every super admin through the server's mail server. Platform admins review events and alerts; super admins acknowledge with a note (audited). No SIEM export, no pager or chat notifications, no anomaly detection beyond these rules.

SEC-024.notes: CodeQL (security-extended) over the TypeScript; Trivy 0.75.0 scans of the API, web and migration images (fail on fixable HIGH/CRITICAL; the migration image is distroless and the unused TypeScript compiler is left out), with secret scanning; pnpm audit --audit-level=critical over all packages. On pull requests, main, weekly and on demand. Vitest raised to 4.1.12 to clear critical tinypool advisories. Not a penetration test; no DAST against a running deployment.

SEC-010.notes: HTTPS_ONLY (API: on in production when APP_URL is https; web: on in production builds): the web app redirects http:// visitors to https:// (308, localhost exempt) and sends HSTS on HTTPS responses; the API refuses non-HTTPS requests (X-Forwarded-Proto across trusted hops) with 403 HTTPS_REQUIRED except /health, and refuses to start with HTTPS_ONLY and TRUST_PROXY_HOPS=0. MONGODB_REQUIRE_TLS refuses an unencrypted MONGODB_URL at startup. System health shows how visitors, the database, email, the AI model, payment gateways and webhooks are protected, and lists HTTP or an unencrypted database as problems in production. TLS ends at the customer's load balancer; no mTLS, no TLS between web and API inside the private network unless T2T_API_URL is https.

SEC-021.notes: node dist/db/backup.js create|verify|drill|restore: whole-database backups from one MongoDB snapshot as gzip canonical Extended JSON (decimals, dates, binary exact) with validators and indexes, AES-256-GCM encrypted (scrypt key from BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY; refused without it unless --unencrypted), SHA-256 and per-collection counts checked before any restore, restore only into an empty database, --keep N rotation, 0600 files. Every run recorded in backup_runs (insert-only) and shown under Platform admin -> Backups. Not built: scheduling and off-site copies (operator's scheduler and storage), incremental backups, per-organisation restore.

SEC-022.notes: Restore drills restore a backup into a scratch database, count every collection against the backup, drop it and record the result. Overdue backups (BACKUP_MAX_AGE_HOURS, default 26) and drills (RESTORE_DRILL_MAX_AGE_DAYS, default 35) show on the Backups page and as System health problems in production. docs/DISASTER_RECOVERY.md: schedule, RPO/RTO targets, provider point-in-time recovery, off-site copies, and the step-by-step recovery runbook. Recovery itself is run by the operator; no automatic failover.

SEC-011.notes: Attachments, tax notice files and vendor portal invoices are stored sealed with AES-256-GCM under the server key (contentKeyId beside the bytes); the upload SHA-256 is checked on every read (FILE_DAMAGED otherwise); guards allow the bytes to change only when sealed again under a new key. Files stored before are read as they are and encrypted from Platform admin -> Encryption keys, which also re-encrypts files after a key rotation (audited). Integration secrets were already sealed (SEC-013); backups are encrypted (SEC-021). Database storage encryption is the deployment's (Atlas, encrypted volumes) and is documented, not detected. Not built: field-level encryption of ledger fields, per-organisation keys, logo and signature images.

SEC-026.notes: Test-account command (two synthetic organisations, one person per role, passwords only in a mode-600 file; refused on production unless allowed for staging), scope and rules of engagement, before and after checklists, and security.txt (RFC 9116) from SECURITY_CONTACT. No external test has been carried out yet.

SEC-027.notes: Product controls mapped to SOC 2 trust services criteria, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A technological controls, and India DPDP Act 2023 / GDPR duties, with the gaps listed (ISMS and policies, personal data export and erasure, privacy notice and consent, breach notice procedure, CSP). Not certified.

SEC-028.notes: CI scans the web app, API messages, public files, docs and README for any sentence pairing a framework (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, DPDP, ...) with a claim word (certified, compliant, attested, ...) unless it denies or defers it; positive and negative cases tested. A framework is allowed only once an assessment is recorded.
